fullDescription: High-octane dark mode promotional design for fitness and performance brands. Features intense fire-orange (#F45B20) accents, 'Clash Grotesk' display typography for heavy impact, and advanced 3D CSS transforms for product presentation. Suitable for high-performance SaaS, fitness tech, sports equipment, and energy-driven mobile apps. Includes 3D phone mockups, floating data badges, mouse-tracking interactive cards, and a subtle grain overlay for a cinematic finish.

structured.summary: A high-performance dark mode promo site with a 3D focus, featuring interactive phone mockups, floating UI badges, and vibrant orange accents against deep blacks and greys. It uses sophisticated perspective-based animations and heavy display typography to create a sense of power and motion.

style.description: The style is 'Cinematic High-Performance'. It utilizes a core palette of deep black (#0A0A0A) and fiery orange (#F45B20). Typography is a mix of high-contrast 'Clash Grotesk' for headlines and clean 'General Sans' for UI elements. Key visual markers include a 3D perspective (1200px), floating sine-wave animations, staggered reveal-up transitions, and a 0.03 opacity SVG grain overlay for texture.
style.prompt: Create a high-performance dark mode UI with the following specs: COLORS: Primary #F45B20 (Fire Orange), BG #0A0A0A (Pure Dark), Cards #1A1A1A, Accents #D94A15. TYPOGRAPHY: Headlines in 'Clash Grotesk' (Bold, 700 weight, tracked tight -0.05em), Body in 'General Sans' (400-500 weight). EFFECTS: 1200px perspective on parent containers. Use a 0.03 opacity fractal noise grain overlay. Use soft glow pulses (#F45B20 at 10% opacity, 96px blur). ANIMATIONS: 3D tilt on phone (rotateY -18deg, rotateX 8deg). Floating animations for badges (sine wave 3.5s-5s). Staggered fade-in-up entrance with 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1).

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical long-form landing page with distinct sections: sticky navigation, split-screen hero with 3D elements, 3-column feature grid, a fanned perspective screenshot gallery, and a centered CTA.

prompts.prompt: Sticky header (height: 64px) with #0A0A0A background and 5% white border-bottom. Left-aligned logo (40px square, 8px radius). Center-aligned text links (size: 14px, color: white/50, hover: white). Right-aligned primary CTA button (#F45B20, 10px radius, 14px font-weight: 600).

Split 50/50 layout. Left side: Tagline badge (orange text, 10% orange bg, pill shape), H1 headline (font-size: 72px, leading: 0.95), body text (white/50, 18px). CTA cluster: Primary orange button with arrow icon + circular play button for demo. Right side: 3D Phone mockup container with 1200px perspective. Phone is tilted (Y: -18deg, X: 8deg) with three floating UI badges surrounding it at different Z-depths (Z: 40px to 50px) and varying float animation delays.

3x2 grid of cards. Cards: #1A1A1A background, 1px white/5% border, 16px radius, 32px padding. Each card has a 56px square icon container with 10% orange background. On hover: Card tilts toward mouse cursor and icon scales 1.15x on the Z-axis (30px translateZ).

Five app screens arranged in a horizontal arc using CSS 3D. Central screen: 1.05x scale, orange border. Lateral screens: Rotated (8deg and 4deg toward center) with white/10% borders. Hovering a screen scales it and moves it up by 8px.

prompts.partPt: Chamada Final para Ação Transformation Section
prompts.prompt: Centered layout with 600px blur glow in background. Large H2 headline (font-size: 60px) with highlighted word in orange. Button cluster: One large primary orange button and two secondary dark buttons with App Store/Play Store icons (60px height, 12px radius).

special_ui_components.description: Cards that react to mouse position by tilting in 3D space.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement cards with 'transform-style: preserve-3d'. On mousemove, calculate delta from center to apply 'rotateX' and 'rotateY' (max 8 degrees). Children (icons/text) should have 'translateZ(40px)' to create a layered parallax depth effect on hover.

special_ui_components.description: A high-fidelity phone frame with depth and floating status badges.
special_ui_components.prompt: A 288px wide phone frame with 40px border radius and 2px internal screen inset. Apply a persistent 'float' keyframe (translateY: -18px) and a 'rotateY(-18deg)' base tilt. Position absolute status badges (e.g., '124 bpm') using 'translateZ(50px)' to ensure they appear to float in front of the screen.
